subject: Multi-trade coordination clash: concrete grade beam clashing with the underground

messages.text: Coordination clash identified: concrete grade beam clashing with the underground electrical duct bank, the plumbing sanitary main, and the mechanical condensate drain routing at Gridline D/7, per Structural Detail 3/S502 vs Structural General Notes S-001. We would like this resolved ahead of the next fabrication release. This clash will require a change order to resolve. This is holding up fabrication release in this area. A response within three weeks would be appreciated.
